comments: REPLACE_WITH_REVIEW_COMMENTS. Approving this gate promotes features/generated/account-access/organization-sign-in.feature into features/approved/, which is the only input to bddgen. Please confirm you accept that no locator has been verified yet - every one will be written as MCP_VALIDATION_REQUIRED and replaced only by the Playwright Test Planner against the real application. AMB-ETA-351-004, AMB-ETA-351-006 and CLR-TP-ETA-351-001 are still unanswered and no amount of application observation will close them.

itemDecisions.comment: Scenario: The login page offers a way to declare the kind of sign-in before any details are entered. Observes the page before any choice is made, so the sign-in choice is deliberately kept out of the Background.
Scenario: Both supported sign-in kinds are offered and can be told apart. Asserts presence and distinguishability only.
Scenario: Choosing organization sign-in makes the page ask for the organization details rather than every possible field. Names no field, pending AMB-ETA-351-001.
Scenario: The password is not readable on screen as it is typed. Types a fabricated secret and never submits it.
Scenario: Correct organization details admit the user to the eCore Command Center Home page. The only scenario using the real account. Stops at arrival.
Scenario: Wrong details do not admit the user and the user is told what happened. Fabricated data only. Asserts no message text.
Scenario: Required details left out do not admit the user and the user is told what happened. Fabricated data only. Generic case only, pending AMB-ETA-351-005.

Scenario: The response to wrong details differs from the response to missing details. Performs two sign-in attempts in one scenario and compares them. Submits two failing attempts, so it must never touch the real account.
